data.why: The repo bundles labeled fluorescence .tif images in test_images/ named subjectID_brainregion.tif, exactly the format and file type the app's file_uploader expects, so no synthetic data is needed.

goals: Upload a set of fluorescence microscopy .tif images of a brain region and get percent-area axonal signal quantified via Otsu thresholding
Compare axonal projection density across brain regions and subjects using the summary data table and plot
Inspect the signal intensity profile along the dorsal-ventral or medial-lateral axis of a brain region
Visually verify the Otsu threshold mask against the raw image via the per-image control plots
Download the summary figures and control plots as PDF for a manuscript or lab notebook
Set the correct pixel size for the microscope objective used to ensure physically accurate area measurements

review.summary: The tree describes AxoDen accurately: upload masked .tif images, set pixel size and masking, check the Otsu segmentation in the per-image control plots, compare % innervation and the axis profiles across regions, and export PDFs. Features are well cut and the cited screens mostly match. It needs a short round of fixes before filing: add the image-preparation stage the README puts first, add table export and group comparison as tasks, and correct two weakly cited nodes (t11's download screen and t4's stepper actions).
